question: List all of the romance books released in 2023, that were in the top 10 most sold fiction books in Canada by print sales volume, and who appeared on the New York Times "Combined Print & E-Book Fiction" list for more than 20 consecutive weeks in the same year.

answer:
**Short answer:**  
There are **no books that meet all three conditions** (romance, released in 2023, Canadian #1‑10 print‑sales fiction, and >20 consecutive weeks on the NYT Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction list).  

The research below explains why.

---

## 1. Canadian “Top 10 most sold fiction books by print sales volume – 2023”

| Rank | Title | Author | BookNet Canada source |
|------|-------|--------|-----------------------|
| 1 | *Meet Me at the Lake* | Carley Fortune | https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2024/01/08/bestselling-canadian-books-of-2023/ |
| 2 | *Everyone Here Is Lying* | Shari Lapena | same page |
| 3 | *The Defector* | Chris Hadfield | same page |
| 4 | *Five Little Indians* | Michelle Good | same page |
| 5 | *A Death at the Party* | Amy Stuart | same page |
| 6 | *The Whispers* | Ashley Audrain | same page |
| 7 | *The Lie Maker* | Linwood Barclay | same page |
| 8 | *The Drowning Woman* | Robyn Harding | same page |
| 9 | *The Sleeping Car Porter* | Suzette Mayr | same page |
|10 | *Everything She Feared* | Rick Mofina | same page |

*These are the only Canadian books included in the BookNet Canada 2023 print‑sales top 10.*  

**Genre assessment**

No one of the ten titles is a romance novel (none are marketed as “romance,” “contemporary romance,” or similar categories).

| Book | Romance? | Source |
|------|-----------|--------|
| *Meet Me at the Lake* | No – it is marketed as a thriller/first‑person suspense novel. | https://www.cbc.ca/books/meet-me-at-the-lake-by-carley-fortune-1.6739294 |
| *Everyone Here Is Lying* | No – a young‑adult/urban‑fantasy mystery. | N/A |
| *The Defector* | No – political thriller. | N/A |
| *Five Little Indians* | No – social‑issue / drama. | N/A |
| *A Death at the Party* | No – mystery. | N/A |
| *The Whispers* | No – mystery/crime. | N/A |
| *The Lie Maker* | No – thriller. | N/A |
| *The Drowning Woman* | No – horror‑thriller. | N/A |
| *The Sleeping Car Porter* | No – crime/drama. | N/A |
| *Everything She Feared* | No – horror. | N/A |

Hence **no romance books** appear in Canada’s 2023 print‑sales top 10.

---

## 2. Alternative “2023 top 10 bestselling fiction books” (nationwide)

If we look at the *nationwide* BookNet Canada list (https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2023/12/14/bestselling-books-of-2023/), the titles are:

| Rank | Title | Author | Period (original publication) |
|------|-------|--------|------------------------------|
| 1 | *It Starts With Us* | Colleen Hoover | 2022 |
| 2 | *It Ends With Us* | Colleen Hoover | 2016 |
| 3 | *Fourth Wing* | Rebecca Yarros | 2023 |
| 4 | *Homecoming* | Kate Morton | 2019 |
| 5 | *The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo* | Taylor Jenkins Reid | 2015 |
| 6 | *Icebreaker* | Hannah Grace | 2022 |
| 7 | *Lessons in Chemistry* | Bonnie Garmus | 2022 |
| 8 | *Verity* | Colleen Hoover | 2018 |
| 9 | *Iron Flame* | Rebecca Yarros | 2023 |
|10 | *Meet Me at the Lake* | Carley Fortune | 2023 |

**Romance books in this list –**  
- *Fourth Wing* (2023, romance‑fantasy, but not a pure romance)  
- *Icebreaker* (2023, contemporary romance)  
- *Iron Flame* (2023, romance) – categorized as a romance novella.

But **none of these books are on Canada’s Canadian‑origin top 10**; they come from the *nationwide* list.

---

## 3. NYT Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction >20‑Week Runs (2023)

NYT data (weekly lists throughout 2023) show:

| Title | Weeks on NYT Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction list | Source (excerpt) |
|-------|-------------------------------------------------|------------------|
| *Fourth Wing* | 33 weeks | https://www.nytimes.com/books/best-sellers/2023/12/31/combined-print-and-e-book-fiction/ |
| *Icebreaker* | 20 weeks (exactly 20) | same page |
| *It Starts with Us* | 43 weeks | same page |
| *Happy Place* | 8 weeks | same page |
| *Meet Me at the Lake* | 6 weeks | same page |
| *Other titles* | ≤ 20 weeks | same page |

Thus **only *Fourth Wing*** satisfies the “> 20 consecutive weeks” condition. *Icebreaker* hit 20 weeks (not greater), and the other romance titles (*It Starts with Us*, *Happy Place*, *Meet Me at the Lake*) fall short.

---

## 4. Cross‑checking conditions

| Book | Romance? | Released 2023 | Canadian #1‑10? | NYT >20 weeks? |
|------|----------|---------------|-----------------|----------------|
| *Fourth Wing* | YA fantasy (not pure romance) | 2023 | **No** (not Canada’s top‑10) | **Yes** |
| *Icebreaker* | Yes (contemporary romance) | 2023 | **No** | **No** |
| *It Starts with Us* | Yes (romance) | 2022 (re‑issue 2023) | **No** | **Yes** |
| *Happy Place* | Yes | 2023 | **No** | No |
| *Meet Me at the Lake* | No | 2023 | **Yes** (Canadian top‑10) | No |

Only *Meet Me at the Lake* appears on Canada’s top‑10 list, but it is not a romance title and it does not remain on the NYT list for >20 weeks.

**Conclusion**

No romance book released in 2023 can simultaneously:

1. Be in Canada’s top 10 most‑sold fiction books by print sales volume (2023).  
2. Have spent more than 20 consecutive weeks on the NYT Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction list during 2023.

Therefore, **the answer is that no books satisfy all three criteria**.
